mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.label, count(v.participant_id) AS votes FROM options o LEFT JOIN votes v ON v.option_id = o.id WHERE o.poll_id = #{pollId} GROUP BY o.id, o.label ORDER BY o.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO votes (poll_id, participant_id, option_id, voted_at) VALUES (#{pollId}, #{participantId}, #{optionId}, now()) ON CONFLICT (poll_id, participant_id) DO UPDATE SET option_id = EXCLUDED.option_id, voted_at = EXCLUDED.voted_at WHERE votes.option_id <> EXCLUDED.option_id
mapper.select: SELECT id, title FROM polls ORDER BY id
SELECT id, label FROM options WHERE poll_id = #{id} ORDER BY id
SELECT p.id, p.title, o.id AS option_id, o.label FROM polls p JOIN options o ON o.poll_id = p.id ORDER BY p.id, o.id
